name: cheap-explore
description: Zero-cost enforcement that the built-in Explore agent stays on a cheap model tier. Explore carries no model pin, so a dispatch can silently run at the full session-model rate, or be explicitly set to opus for a plain file sweep. A PreToolUse hook denies any Explore dispatch whose model isn't haiku or sonnet and tells the model to retry. Injects nothing at session start — costs tokens only on an actual miss. Gated agent list is configurable via CHEAP_AGENTS.
